ShortDescription.Value: Change zoning on the sides of roads: Left/Right/Both/None. Flip with RMB, apply with LMB.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Easy Zoning [EZ]
Custom zoning for new and existing roads and includes Contour on/off toggle.
## Features - Includes Contour Topography toggle (on/off) - **Right-Click** flips preview (Left↔Right or Both↔None) - Small vanilla-style “Zone Change” panel beside Roads - Hover to Preview and remembers your last selection - Options to protect existing buildings and already-zoned grids - Launch: Top-left icon or **Ctrl + Z** hotkey
## How to use
**New Road:** open game **Roads** panel → select the **Zoning** icon desired, draw roads as usual.
**Existing Road:** 1. Open EZ panel > use Top Left icon or Ctrl+Z keybind. 2. Select the Zone icon (see image) > Hover a road to preview. 3. **Right-Click** to switch sides; **Left-Click** to apply. 4. Bonus: moving the mouse a little to the left or right of the road will also flip the side. 5. NEW: toggle display of Contour terrain lines on as needed.
## Compatibility - No Harmony, extends vanilla UI - Uses native input and sounds
## Support and feedback - If mod helps you, give it a Like, it's free. - Feedback to GitHub, Discord, or forum links on this page.
## Tech notes
- For newly drawn roads, the zoning side **←|→** is relative to the road segment’s internal orientation. At certain diagonal angles, one-sided zoning (↖||↗) may be assigned to the other side (just swap it).
